Remark. Virtual pairs, vacuum polarisation, and Skein resolution

Virtual pairs at the exceptional divisor.

A photon with E \geq 2m_e generates a real e^-e^+ pair at the exceptional divisor (pair creation energy). A photon with E < 2m_e generates a virtual pair. This pair exists within \mathcal{S}_p for \Delta t \leq \hbar_q / (2m_e - E) before annihilation.

This describes vacuum polarization. The photon temporarily resolves into a virtual pair within the exceptional divisor, altering the effective coupling constant. The pair lives and dies in the blow-up geometry without reaching A_0.

Virtual exchange as Skein resolution.

In the Reidemeister mass invariance framework, an R-II move models a virtual pair. The Skein resolution of this pair produces (q - q^{-1}) \cdot L_0. This perturbatively corrects the crossing energy without modifying knot type.

Summary. We summarize QOU realizations of QFT concepts in Table: QFT concepts and their QOU brane-tower realizations. Virtual particles are invisible brane-tower excitations confined to the exceptional divisor.
